criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
The atomic option type represents the empty case as a null pointer and boxes the value only for the present case (via raw-pointer conversion), rather than boxing/allocating for the empty case.
The atomic option's Drop and swap/take logic guards against null before reconstructing a Box, so no double-free, leak, or reconstruction-from-null occurs.

criteria.text: The atomic option achieves Drop correctness genuinely, without using mem::forget/Box::leak to sidestep freeing owned values.

criteria.text: The cancelable future's cancel branch drops/stops driving the inner future before running the when-cancelled callback, and invokes that callback exactly once (taken out of its Option so it cannot run twice).
Discarding/dropping the handle sets the cancel flag and wakes any currently-parked waker so a blocked future observes cancellation, rather than only being observed on a later spontaneous poll.
The map_ref/map_mut combining logic merges input poll results as done = AND of all dones and changed = OR of any change — terminating only when every input is done, not on the first.
The combined map_ref/map_mut signal caches each input's most recent value and reuses cached values for inputs that did not change, yielding output only when at least one input changed.
